parts.name: hull_top
parts.note: Clamshell upper half: skin; kick saddle beside the centreline (low fairing round the worm N20, which drops in with its stub down the inboard slot); teardrop ear fin with an F693ZZ for the hub screw; two faired pivot blocks (coupler bores; their carved faces are the deploy and fold stops of the drill arms); saddle, ear and blocks are tangent-arc outlines with r 1.2 edges and r 1.5 skirts into the skin; a slot over the nose spigot where the kick pole lands; wire holes. Radial M3 clearance at z=+3 into tray disc 1 and the tail spigot
parts.orient: split face down (on the bed), saddle up

parts.name: hull_bottom
parts.note: Clamshell lower half: plain Ø42 cylinder (launcher cradle surface). Radial M3 clearance at z=-3 into tray disc 1 and the tail spigot

parts.name: nose
parts.note: Blunt hollow nose: Ø22 flat tip with the Ø9.8 lens hole, Caddx Ant pocket 14.4 x 15.0 (slides in from the back, 1.2 lip + lens recess hold it), 1.5 walls; a round-cornered flute along the top (solid underneath) where the planted kick pole lies: its floor is the kick rest; spigot with a groove that the hull rib locks when the clamshell closes
parts.orient: tip down on the bed (flat Ø22), spigot up

parts.name: tail_cap
parts.note: Tail cap: 4 radial M3 from the hull through its spigot ring into the boom anchor disc inside it; the boom's square shank runs through a keyed square hole in the end wall (the pusher face is still the flat ring round it). Top: recessed seat for the JST-XH 2-pin power loop socket (the ON plug, reachable with the dart on the launcher). Bottom: recessed seat for the JST-XH 3-pin charge socket (bench only)
parts.orient: end face down, spigot up (no supports)

parts.name: tail_boom
parts.note: Tail boom (tether stinger), PPA-CF: 28 mm behind the tail, 9 x 9 rounded, clevis eye with a steel M3 x 8 countersunk screw as the line's wear pin (flush both sides). The tow load goes head -> anchor disc -> the 4 tail screws -> hull; the square shank is keyed in the tail cap
parts.orient: lying on its side (layers along the boom), PPA-CF

parts.name: boom_anchor
parts.note: Boom anchor disc Ø32.2 x 3.6 inside the tail spigot: holds the boom head in a recess; the four radial tail screws run through the hull and the tail cap spigot into it, so the tether pulls on the hull, not on the tail cap

parts.name: tray
parts.note: One-piece spine nose to tail: disc 1 (4 radial M3 from the hull), sled (deploy-N20 cradle, MP1584 on the keel, DRV8833 #3 shelf), disc 2, 3 decks (BNO085 / XIAO + DRV#1 / DRV#2 + INA219), disc 3, cell bay (2 x 18350 side by side on saddles, BMS stick under them, VTX deck over them), disc 4. Battery contact recesses for a 2xAA-holder contact set
parts.orient: keel down on the bed; discs stand up, decks bridge 26 mm between discs

parts.name: kick_leg
parts.note: Kick leg on the dart centreline: Ø12 x 11.5 hub on the +y stub of the kick N20 (which sits beside it), M3 x 8 screw from outside through the ear F693ZZ into the hub end; Ø8 pole (flat-sided to the print datum, those corners r 3.5 to fit the nose flute) with a Ø4.6 wire channel, a web up to the foot housing, which is tilted 20.75 deg about the foot N20's output shaft so the foot auger plants vertical on the dart axis ahead of the nose (output up and leaning aft when folded)
parts.orient: on its side (pole axis horizontal, hub face down)

parts.name: foot_auger
parts.note: Foot gimlet Ø13 x 68, core Ø7 tapering to a sharp point, right-hand anchor flight (load face toward the housing 45 deg), D-bore on the foot N20 output shaft (7 mm engaged), M3 grub screw in the hub; its base runs 0.3 over the housing so drilling push goes into the housing, not the worm gearbox

parts.name: drill_leg_L
parts.note: Drill arm: round head on the Ø7 D coupler (flat front face = stop face on the hull's pivot block), short neck with the motor-lead channel, thrust shoulder for the sleeve, stationary bushing Ø15.8 that holds the drill gearmotor by its can (flats key it; a drop of CA holds it axially), 1.2 mm terminal room behind it (bend the tabs up)
parts.orient: standing on the head's flat front face (local -x down), no supports

parts.name: drill_leg_L_auger
parts.note: Tapered drill auger, right-hand (the pair counter-rotates and both screw in): a Ø18.7 hub round the stationary motor (bore 16.3 over the 15.6 gearbox diagonal; it runs on the arm's bushing and its base face on the arm shoulder), then past the gearbox face a gimlet: core Ø9.6 -> Ø6, anchor flight Ø16 at pitch 12 (load face toward the motor 45 deg, leading face 30 deg) over 34 mm, tapering to a sharp point over 22 mm; 92.6 long from the arm shoulder. The motor's M3 shaft runs down its centre as a steel spine to 9.8 mm from the point: it screws through M3 nut A (pressed in the hex pocket at the end of the hub bore, threadlocker) and self-taps the Ø2.6 spine bore
parts.orient: standing on its base (point up), brim 5 mm

parts.name: drill_leg_L_motor
parts.note: Drill gearmotor 12 x 10, gearbox 11.95, 24.27 face to back (measured): fixed in the arm, inside the sleeve

parts.name: drill_leg_L_shaft
parts.note: M3 threaded motor shaft Ø2.84 x 56.03 (measured): the auger's steel spine (through nut A, self-tapped into the Ø2.6 spine bore)

parts.name: drill_leg_L_nut
parts.note: M3 nut A pressed into the hex pocket at the end of the hub bore (a drop of CA; threadlocker on the shaft): the shaft screws through it, so the auger is driven by the nut and the self-tapped spine bore

parts.name: drill_leg_R
parts.note: Drill arm: round head on the Ø7 D coupler (flat front face = stop face on the hull's pivot block), short neck with the motor-lead channel, thrust shoulder for the sleeve, stationary bushing Ø15.8 that holds the drill gearmotor by its can (flats key it; a drop of CA holds it axially), 1.2 mm terminal room behind it (bend the tabs up)
parts.orient: standing on the head's flat front face (local -x down), no supports

parts.name: drill_leg_R_auger
parts.note: Tapered drill auger, left-hand (the pair counter-rotates and both screw in): a Ø18.7 hub round the stationary motor (bore 16.3 over the 15.6 gearbox diagonal; it runs on the arm's bushing and its base face on the arm shoulder), then past the gearbox face a gimlet: core Ø9.6 -> Ø6, anchor flight Ø16 at pitch 12 (load face toward the motor 45 deg, leading face 30 deg) over 34 mm, tapering to a sharp point over 22 mm; 92.6 long from the arm shoulder. The motor's M3 shaft runs down its centre as a steel spine to 9.8 mm from the point: it screws through M3 nut A (pressed in the hex pocket at the end of the hub bore, threadlocker) and self-taps the Ø2.6 spine bore
parts.orient: standing on its base (point up), brim 5 mm

parts.name: drill_leg_R_motor
parts.note: Drill gearmotor 12 x 10, gearbox 11.95, 24.27 face to back (measured): fixed in the arm, inside the sleeve

parts.name: drill_leg_R_shaft
parts.note: M3 threaded motor shaft Ø2.84 x 56.03 (measured): the auger's steel spine (through nut A, self-tapped into the Ø2.6 spine bore)

parts.name: drill_leg_R_nut
parts.note: M3 nut A pressed into the hex pocket at the end of the hub bore (a drop of CA; threadlocker on the shaft): the shaft screws through it, so the auger is driven by the nut and the self-tapped spine bore

parts.name: coupler_L
parts.note: Ø7 D coupler (PPA-CF): D-socket on the deploy N20 output stub, runs through the pivot block bore into the arm head; its outer end stands 0.3 proud in the head counterbore, the printed pod cap and an M3 x 8 screw seat on it (the arm floats 0.7, never clamped)
parts.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF

parts.name: coupler_R
parts.note: Ø7 D coupler (PPA-CF): D-socket on the deploy N20 output stub, runs through the pivot block bore into the arm head; its outer end stands 0.3 proud in the head counterbore, the printed pod cap and an M3 x 8 screw seat on it (the arm floats 0.7, never clamped)
parts.orient: lying on its D flat (layers along the axle), PPA-CF

parts.name: cell_1
parts.note: 18350 Ø18.66 x 36.87 incl. button (measured), 2S, contacts both ends

parts.name: cell_2
parts.note: 18350 Ø18.66 x 36.87 incl. button (measured), 2S, contacts both ends

parts.name: n20_kick
parts.note: KICK worm N20 (33.04 long), worm box at the nose end, beside the centreline; output shaft across Y = the kick pivot, its +y stub carries the hub

parts.name: kick_shaft
parts.note: kick N20 output shaft (turns with the leg): the +y stub carries the hub; the unused -y stub is cut to 1 mm past the worm box (it stays inside the saddle pocket)

parts.name: n20_deploy
parts.note: DEPLOY worm N20 on the axle line, body forward in the tray cradle

parts.name: deploy_shaft
parts.note: deploy N20 output shaft (turns with the couplers), both stubs in the couplers

parts.name: xiao
parts.note: xiao 17.74 x 22.75 x 4.49 (measured)

parts.name: ina219
parts.note: ina219 25.69 x 20.32 x 4.70 (measured)

parts.name: bno085
parts.note: bno085 22.77 x 25.72 x 4.77 (measured)

parts.name: vtx
parts.note: vtx 42.25 x 19.91 x 6.01 (measured)

parts.name: bms_2s
parts.note: bms_2s 40.80 x 8.00 x 2.10 (measured)

parts.name: camera
parts.note: Caddx Ant 13.99 x 14.59, 18.34 front to back (measured)

parts.name: n20_foot
parts.note: FOOT worm N20 in the housing, output up when folded (lower stub trimmed to 2 mm or single-shaft version)

parts.name: foot_shaft
parts.note: foot N20 output shaft, 9 proud, D flat facing the hull nose side

parts.name: screws_radial
parts.note: 8 x M3 x 8 countersunk (flat-head) radial screws, flush with the skin: 4 into tray disc 1, 4 through the tail cap spigot into the boom anchor disc (they carry the tow)

parts.name: boom_pin
parts.note: M3 x 8 countersunk screw: the tether's wear pin in the boom eye (head flush in the top tine, threads 2 mm into the bottom tine, nothing proud; threadlocker)

parts.name: brg_ear
parts.note: F693ZZ in the ear, flange down in a counterbore on the outer face, inner face 0.4 proud of the fin onto the hub's inner-race boss

parts.name: kick_hub_screw
parts.note: M3 x 8 through the ear bearing into the hub end (turns with the leg; its tip stops 0.4 short of the kick N20 shaft end); the head clamps the inner race onto the hub's printed boss

parts.name: pod_cap_L
parts.note: Printed pod cap Ø10 x 1.5: sits on the coupler end inside the pod counterbore, the M3 x 8 screw goes through it into the coupler; it overlaps the pod head by 1.4 mm so the pod cannot walk off the coupler (an M3 washer, Ø7, is smaller than the Ø7.25 pod bore and would not hold it)

parts.name: coupler_L_screw
parts.note: M3 x 8 through the pod cap into the coupler end (turns with it)

parts.name: pod_cap_R
parts.note: Printed pod cap Ø10 x 1.5: sits on the coupler end inside the pod counterbore, the M3 x 8 screw goes through it into the coupler; it overlaps the pod head by 1.4 mm so the pod cannot walk off the coupler (an M3 washer, Ø7, is smaller than the Ø7.25 pod bore and would not hold it)

parts.name: coupler_R_screw
parts.note: M3 x 8 through the pod cap into the coupler end (turns with it)

parts.name: contacts_front_springs
parts.note: 2xAA-holder springs joined by wire 2 (front of the cell bay)

parts.name: contacts_rear_plates
parts.note: flat contact plates at the back of the cell bay (B- cell 1, B+ cell 2)

parts.name: jst_charge
parts.note: JST-XH 3-pin charge socket (B-, BM, B+), header body 5.75 x 9.9 x 7.0 plus pins, recessed in the tail cap bottom seat; plug in on the bench only

parts.name: jst_loop
parts.note: JST-XH 2-pin power loop socket (header 5.75 x 7.4 x 7.0, pins trimmed to 2.3 after soldering: the boom shank runs under them) with the shorting plug and its wire loop on top (ends at z 19.6, under the skin at 20.7): the ON switch, top of the tail cap

parts.name: antenna
parts.note: VTX u.FL 5.8 GHz antenna along the top through the disc 4 notch, tip ahead of the power socket seat (PLA is transparent to 5.8 GHz)

parts.name: xiao_antenna
parts.note: XIAO 2.4 GHz FPC antenna (comes with the XIAO ESP32S3; about 20 x 12, NOT measured): stick it flat to the inside of the hull top over the board bay, u.FL to the XIAO

parts.name: capacitor
parts.note: 470 to 1000 uF across the MP1584 5 V output (long leg to OUT+)
